Dear all,
As part of my work on high-stakes testing, I have a few questions related to composite scores and conditional standard errors of measurement (CSEMs):

1- How can I effectively combine thetas (estimated in unidimensional IRT models) from three subtests (math, science, and English reading) to create a composite score?
   

2.  how to compute CSEMs for the composite score?


Your insights would be greatly appreciated. Thank you in advance!

Best regards,
